WITH monthlyaggregations AS (

                END) AS "M-5",
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN date_trunc('month'::text, no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.order_date::timestamp with time zone) = (date_trunc('month'::text, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone) - '4 mons'::interval) THEN no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.orders
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END) AS "M-4",
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN date_trunc('month'::text, no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.order_date::timestamp with time zone) = (date_trunc('month'::text, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone) - '3 mons'::interval) THEN no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.orders
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END) AS "M-3",
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN date_trunc('month'::text, no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.order_date::timestamp with time zone) = (date_trunc('month'::text, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone) - '2 mons'::interval) THEN no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.orders
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END) AS "M-2",
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN date_trunc('month'::text, no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.order_date::timestamp with time zone) = (date_trunc('month'::text, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone) - '1 mon'::interval) THEN no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.orders
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END) AS "M-1",
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN date_trunc('month'::text, no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.order_date::timestamp with time zone) = date_trunc('month'::text, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone) THEN no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.orders
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END) AS current_m_actual
           FROM opendata_nodata.no_model_for_all_domain_pincode
          WHERE no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.order_date >= (date_trunc('month'::text, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone) - '5 mons'::interval) AND no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.order_date < CURRENT_DATE AND no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.orders > 0 AND no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.orders IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.domain, no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.category, no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.delivery_pincode, no_model_for_all_domain_pincode.seller_pincode

    "M-5",

    current_m_actual AS "M",
    round(current_m_actual::double precision / date_part('day'::text, CURRENT_DATE) * date_part('day'::text, date_trunc('month'::text, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon -1 days'::interval)) AS "Forecast"
